name: The Cinderwood
finalLine: The Heartwood is cleansed. Broceliande breathes again.
notes: deathLossPct 1 - a death ends the run

name: Hag's Causeway
introText: Beyond the last of the burnt trees, the ground turns soft. The old road sinks into black water, and the water does not give things back. They call this place Hag's Causeway, though no one living has seen her. Here the dead do not stay buried.
finalLine: The Bog King sinks for the last time. The Causeway falls quiet.
notes: TUNING - deathLossPct 0.5: on death each resource keeps floor(50%) and each item is lost at 50%, twists come in M3b and M3c

name: The Lost Vale
introText: The road out of the Causeway climbs, and the air turns warm and green. Ferns taller than houses close over the path, and old stone steps lead down into the mist. Somewhere ahead, something is watching. This is the Lost Vale. Its people do not welcome strangers.
finalLine: The Iron Oracle falls silent. Beyond the Ironspan, the Vale waits.
notes: TUNING - deathLossPct 0.55, 1 Trader and 1 Tinker's Rest plus Rootkeeper Grove (a village row in the levels tab)
